name: Book of Exalted Deeds

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book. Artifact random properties use the game's condensed tables (deviations.md).

magic.attunement: by a creature of good alignment

powers.name: Study it (80 hours)
powers.text: Spend 80 hours over 10 days reading it: +2 Wisdom (to 24) and a halo of light; you're never again quite the same.

summary: The definitive treatise on good: study it for +2 Wisdom (to 24) and a radiant halo; evil creatures who touch it burn.
text: The definitive treatise on all that is good in the multiverse, the fabled Book of Exalted Deeds figures prominently in many religions. A creature attuned to it must spend 80 hours reading and studying it to digest its contents and reap its benefits; that creature's Wisdom score then increases by 2, to a maximum of 24, and it can't benefit from the book again. The creature also gains a halo that sheds Bright Light in a 10-foot radius and Dim Light for an additional 10 feet, and it has Advantage on Charisma (Persuasion) checks against good creatures. A non-good creature that touches the book takes 5d6 Radiant damage. The book has two minor beneficial properties and one major beneficial property. (The game doesn't track alignment: anyone in the party may study it.)
